---
name: Feature Request / Architecture Proposal
about: Suggest an idea, new provider, or architectural enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it integrates into the ShortForge / FactoryOS control or execution plane.

## Architectural Boundaries
- Which floor or service does this modify? (e.g. F01-F06, F07 Guardian, Compute Provider, Intelligence Layer)
- Does this introduce new contracts or schemas?

## Economy & Verification Implications
- **Token Impact**: Estimated token cost and cacheability.
- **Compute Impact**: GPU/CPU/Memory requirements.
- **Verification Gate**: What physical or cryptographic evidence proves correctness (`CLAIM <= EVIDENCE`)?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
